scope: Deterministic rooted Moore controllers with at most four states; uniform random anchor RSA; periodic square lattice
symmetry: Draw one global H/V exchange per realization. It selects a symmetry-equivalent concrete controller, uses no evolving extra controller state, and is shared with temporal nulls.

selection.capRule: If needed, sort selected classes by frequency of winning budget cells, then Pareto status, coverage, canonical id. Preserve every lower-memory and temporal comparator.

confirmation.adjustment: Holm across all locked candidates, k values, nulls and three metrics

largeSizeGate: For a two-bit claim, new candidate must pass simultaneous density superiority and abs_order/cost noninferiority against every one of the 16 live temporal comparators with <=4 states at L64, including three-state candidates within the two-bit budget. The one-bit subset separately uses <=2-state comparators. Otherwise no new L256+ search.
claims: Structural enumeration is complete; Monte Carlo performance search is multifidelity and cannot establish absence of improvements among every pruned class at larger lattices. Ordinary mean Pareto points are exploratory, not simultaneous confidence frontiers.
